answer: Each trading identity must lock a bond and build reputation through checked work before it can influence the economy. Random audits compare its claims with those of unrelated agents; a colluding Sybil that submits inconsistent results triggers slashing, sending a ripple through its linked accounts. Creating many fakes therefore multiplies the attacker’s required capital and forces each account to earn fresh history. The voyage to profitable control becomes expensive, while the river of honest records exposes shortcuts.
